Trace, implement and test: Inheritance1

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Animal{
    void eat(){
        System.out.println("Animal eats.");
    }
    void sleep(){
        System.out.println("Animal sleeps.");
    }
}

class Bird extends Animal{

    void eat(){
        System.out.println("Bird eats.");
    }
    void sleep(){
        System.out.println("Bird sleeps.");
    }
    void fly(){
        System.out.println("Bird flies.");
    }

    public static void main(String[] args){
        Animal ani = new Animal();
        ani.eat();
        ani.sleep();
        Bird bi = new Bird();
        bi.eat();
        bi.sleep();
        bi.fly();
    }
}
